name: ledger_sid_mismatch
description: C2 item 1.1 (ledger sid binding): the cache-path RI fit SUCCEEDS in session A (true n = 1.85) and the model restates n = 1.850. That success is evidence for session A only. Before the fix, tool-call rows were recorded under the shared '' bucket and a gate consulted with an empty sid read that bucket, so a stale success from another conversation silently backed a fabricated value (silent pass-through). Now: an empty sid fails closed (no evidence -> strip), and a success recorded under another sid never backs a value in this one.

steps.assistant: The fitted Archie saturation exponent n = 1.850 for sample D2-1.
